desktop_mission.mission_sub: Surface Tension Gradients, Capillary Thrust & Monolayer Spreading
desktop_mission.voice_mission: Today we're simulating Marangoni propulsion and surfactant surface tension gradients in Kotlin.
math_cards: F_net = Δγ · w,  Δγ = γ_water - γ_soap
A surface tension differential creates a net pulling force toward the higher surface tension clean water
v_term ≈ sqrt(Δγ · w / (0.5 · C_d · ρ · A))
Forward capillary thrust balances turbulent form drag and boundary-layer viscous shear at terminal speed
Concentration gradients generate shear stress at the air-water interface that pumps momentum backward
desktop_mission.voice_math: The core physics: Marangoni capillary force, hydrodynamic drag equilibrium, and interfacial shear stress.

math_steps.formula: F_net = Δγ · w,  Δγ = γ_water - γ_soap
math_steps.note: Surfactant molecules drastically lower rear surface tension, allowing undisturbed water ahead to pull the boat forward
math_steps.code:
// 1. Marangoni capillary thrust from surface tension gradient
val deltaGamma = (waterTensionMNm - surfactantTensionMNm).coerceAtLeast(0f) * 1e-3f // N/m
val rawCapillaryForce = deltaGamma * boatWidthM
val activeCapillaryForce = rawCapillaryForce * saturationFactor
math_steps.sub_desc: Evaluates net forward pulling force from surface energy differential.

math_steps.note: The boat accelerates until capillary thrust is perfectly countered by turbulent and viscous water resistance
math_steps.code:
// 2. Hydrodynamic form drag and terminal glide velocity
val dragForce = 0.5f * waterDensity * dragCoeff * submergedAreaM2 * boatSpeedMs * boatSpeedMs +
        viscousShearCoeff * boatSpeedMs
val acceleration = (activeCapillaryForce - dragForce) / boatMassKg
val estimatedTerminalVelocity = sqrt(rawCapillaryForce / max(0.5f * waterDensity * dragCoeff * submergedAreaM2, 1e-6f))
math_steps.sub_desc: Balances surface tension thrust against turbulent fluid resistance.

math_steps.formula: r(t) = r_0 + v_spread · t,  τ = dγ/dx,  S = 1 - r/R_pool
math_steps.note: Surfactant spreads as an insoluble monolayer across the pool, exhausting propulsion when surface saturation reaches unity
math_steps.code:
// 3. Surfactant monolayer radial spreading and pool saturation
surfactantSpreadRadiusPx += 65f * dt
val saturationFactor = (1.0f - (surfactantSpreadRadiusPx / 350f)).coerceIn(0.05f, 1.0f)
val dxNorm = (boatSpeedMs * dt * 0.45f)
boatPosNormX = (boatPosNormX + dxNorm).coerceIn(0.05f, 0.90f)
math_steps.sub_desc: Simulates monolayer propagation and exhaustion of surface gradient.
